nodes.label: Server-only DB Credentials
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL never leaves the server; browser talks only to API routes, guarded by a read-only role, LIMIT caps, and a 5s statement timeout.

nodes.label: Exact + Semantic Dedup
nodes.rationale: sha256 URL/title hashes catch exact dups; app-side cosine over local embeddings catches near-dups (threshold 0.92).

nodes.label: Idempotent Atomic Dispatch
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(offer_id, channel) + a claimed_at lease guarantee no double-sends across re-runs or concurrent workers.

nodes.label: Local Embeddings (no API key)
nodes.rationale: sentence-transformers computes embeddings locally for semantic dedup; if torch can't install, pipeline falls back to sha256 exact dedup.

nodes.label: Manual Ingest Fallback
nodes.rationale: Facebook is not scraped; a manual paste form / CLI inserts raw_items under a manual source, reusing the same pipeline with zero legal surface.

nodes.label: Pydantic v2 Offer Schema
nodes.rationale: Strict schema validates/normalizes every LLM extraction: enum fallbacks, currency casing, tz-aware expiry, confidence bounds.

nodes.label: Rate Safety & Backoff
nodes.rationale: Dispatcher paces under Discord 30 msg/min and honors 429 Retry-After; LLM extractor retries 429/5xx with backoff.

nodes.label: Ingest→Normalize→Verify→Dedup→Dispatch Pipeline
nodes.rationale: One orchestrator turns raw_items into offers and hands them to the dispatcher; each stage is isolated so one bad item never kills a run.

nodes.label: Normalized Adapter Payload Contract
nodes.rationale: Every adapter emits one identical JSON shape stored verbatim in raw_items.raw_payload, so downstream code is source-agnostic.

nodes.label: Telegram Flood Discipline
nodes.rationale: MTProto user-account client, sequential 1 req/1-2s, 50 msgs/channel/run, FloodWait capped at 15min; a banned account is a service incident.

nodes.label: Stealth Tarpit Breaker
nodes.rationale: A login wall / px-captcha trips a breaker that screenshots, disables the identity 24h, and alerts — never auto-solve CAPTCHAs.

nodes.label: Crash-safe Watermark Resume
nodes.rationale: channel_cursors(last_message_id) is bumped only after a batch is fully persisted, so a crash resumes without gaps or dupes.

nodes.label: DDG vs Serper Engine Routing
nodes.rationale: ddgs ignores site:/OR/quoted operators; operator queries must route to --engine serper or they underperform.

nodes.label: Relay Fraud / 跑路 Denylist
nodes.rationale: Commercial 中转 relays risk exit-scam and 降智 (silent model downgrade); durable free access lives in first-party platforms and BYOK OSS routers.

nodes.label: Curated Free-LLM GitHub Targets
nodes.rationale: Auto-refreshed awesome-list repos safe to ingest via github_adapter; reaches prod today since the worker runs github every 6h.

nodes.label: LLM Aggregator Landscape (proposed wiring)
nodes.rationale: Snapshot of 'one key, many models' services; proposes new deep_web query templates and github_adapter targets, not yet applied.

nodes.label: Proposed Aggregator Query Templates
nodes.rationale: New (category_tag, query) tuples for deep_web_adapter, split by DDG-safe vs Serper-only (site:/OR/quotes) engines.

nodes.label: Heroku Worker + Scheduler Topology
nodes.rationale: Only the Telegram monitor must run 24/7 (worker dyno); everything else is idempotent batch work in free Scheduler one-offs.

nodes.label: Local Dev Stack (Postgres + Redis)
nodes.rationale: docker-compose mirrors Heroku's topology: Postgres 16 for the offer store, Redis 7 for rate buckets and dedup scratch.

nodes.label: Scheduler One-off Batch Jobs
nodes.rationale: Pipeline, dispatcher, and per-source ingest run as cron-ish one-offs that only burn dyno hours while executing.
